models.affine: Immutable original AV 256 RANSAC attempts, fit-bit-error <=12 and CHECK >=96 correct bits before graph inference
models.feistel: Immutable AY 256 task-key search with two-round family-aligned function and CHECK >=96 before graph inference
models.router: Fit both original source-blind models from the exact same public 40 FIT examples and score both on the same public 8 CHECK examples. Disqualify affine on 12-bit-error budget failure; both require CHECK >=96. If only one eligible choose it. If both eligible require absolute CHECK-correct difference strictly greater than specified margin or abstain; choose higher CHECK. On exact tie abstain. No source op name, hidden key, graph truth, graph predicted label or evaluator-derived task class given to router. Freeze router before research. No mixed edge encoding; route entire task, preserve original per-node state 7 active+9 retained.
models.structural_disclosure: Feistel-key branch deliberately uses generator-aligned frozen parametric inductive bias. Positive transfer is family-conditional, not operator-agnostic discovery.

gate.FIT: A joint arm may be elected from 24 TRAIN-FIT pairs only if FP=0, Feistel paired>=1, paired >= strongest same-query-count affine control + 1, AND its accepted original affine positive case IDs include every baseline-accepted positive in the same-query-count matched affine arm. Rank max paired, then minimum model CPU, then arm name. If none, no DEV. Preserve all arms even with negative results.
gate.SCREEN: Independently evaluate all eight unchanged arms on held TRAIN-SCREEN only after frozen FIT selection. Same exact requirements with zero FP, nonzero Feistel paired, strict paired advantage and 100% retention of the matched same-query affine control's accepted original positive case IDs. Fail closed on any violated criterion. No SCREEN retuning, no alternate arm promotion.
gate.DEV: No DEV birth or evaluation during this gate. Requires later separately frozen first-use and independent qualification if and only if FIT+SCREEN pass.
